thread:
ana: Heads-up: prep for the "Latency & Cost Playbook" deliverables for next week's webinar + post. We need concrete visuals, tight copy, and clear lead routing. Quick ideas?

mike: For visuals: 1) dual-axis scatter (median latency vs $/1k tokens) where each marker is a model+config. 2) stacked bar showing relative cost breakdown (compute, infra, amortization) per 1k tokens for typical prompts. 3) small waterfall highlighting Dedicated savings.

talia: +1 scatter but group by prompt bucket: chat(<=64), assistant(256), long(1k+). Use small multiples for clarity instead of color only. Designers hate overplotting.

harper: Messaging angles: "Ship fast: sub-100ms med latency for chat" and "Cut inference spend per 1k tokens by up to X%". Also include a short FAQ slide: how we measure $/1k (what's included).

mike: Data notes: we'll show median & 95p latency. For cost, present $/1k tokens normalized to a baseline model. Annotate any quantization/throughput tradeoffs. Also provide CSV for designers with columns: model, config, prompt_bucket, median_ms, p95_ms, cost_per_1k_usd, rps.

ana (via sam-bot): infra-bot: benchmark snapshot uploaded at 1872011200 -> bench-v2-1872011200.csv. Contains base, quantized, optimized variants across 3 prompt buckets.

mike: Saw it. Quick stat: optimized variant reduces median by ~40% and $/1k by ~25% vs base for assistant-length prompts. Quantized gives best $/1k on long prompts but p95 degrades for small prompts. We'll call out that tradeoff.

talia: Callouts for copy: "Best for interactive chat" vs "Best for high-volume batch". For the blog, open with a one-liner: "How we think about latency vs cost when serving real apps". Avoid buzzwords; be concrete.

harper: CTA plan: two CTAs on post + webinar slide: 1) "Start free: 10k tokens" (self-serve) 2) "Contact sales: Dedicated & Private" (form with checkboxes for org_size/use_case). Add a routing rule: regulated OR org_size > 500 -> AE triage.

mike: Webinar demo idea: 3 terminals side-by-side showing same prompt on base/quant/optimized, with live timer and an overlay of cumulative cost as tokens emit. If demo flaps, fallback to pre-recorded video.

talia: For charts, microcopy snippets: under scatter: "Each marker = model + tuning; size = throughput; inset shows p95." Under cost waterfall: "Dedicated amortizes infra, lowering unit price for sustained throughput." Keep each blurb to one sentence.

harper: Marketing form fields: email, org_name, org_size (buckets), use_case (consumer, internal, regulated), estimated_monthly_tokens, preferred_contact. Lead scoring: immediate ping to AE for regulated, or >1M tokens/month.

sam-bot: prodtool: queued task to export cleaned CSV to /drive/marketing/bench_playbook_1872011200.csv.

mike: I'll prepare the three charts as PNG+SVG and a CSV summary with median/p95/$ for each prompt bucket by EOD. Talia, could you draft the microcopy and the one-liner?

talia: On it. I'll post drafts in this thread tomorrow morning.

harper: I'll mock the form + routing rules and share the gating logic. We should also add a single slide: "How to pick the right configuration" with a 3-step checklist.

ana (via sam-bot): reminder: include a short appendix in the post describing measurement methodology (hardware, batch settings, measurement windows). Helps preempt PRs.

mike: Good call. We'll include a methodology footnote and make raw bench CSV available for reviewers.

ana: Next steps recap: mike = charts & CSV; talia = microcopy + headline; harper = form & routing; sam-bot will publish bench CSV and nudge when ready. Check-in tomorrow 10am. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
